select * from EDS.LOANS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER_AAS_VW


CREATE VIEW EDS.LOAN_DASHBOARD_VW
AS
SELECT loan_fact.as_of_date
	, loan_fact.gam_bank_id bank_id
	, loan_fact.gam_acid acid
	, aas.acct_poa_as_rec_type
	, acct_name
	, aas.cust_id
	, foracid
	, payoff_flg
	, payoff_date
	,CASE 
		WHEN PAYOFF_FLG = 'Y' AND LAM.PAYOFF_DATE <= date_dim.fulldate AND SCHM_TYPE IN ('LAA', 'CLA') THEN 'C'
		WHEN SCHM_TYPE IN ('LAA','CLA') AND CLR_BAL_AMT = 0 AND ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' THEN 'C'
		ELSE 'A'
	END AS LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS
	, sol_id
	, gam_schm_code
	, gam_schm_type
	, acct_crncy_code
	, relationship_exposure
	, relationship_exposure_php
	, gam_source_code
	, acct_opn_date
	, acct_cls_date
	, billed_amount
	, billed_amount_php
	, credit_limit
	, credit_limit_php
FROM eds.eds_ctl
JOIN eds.date_dim
	ON (
			date_dim.fulldate = eds_ctl.loans_date
			OR (
					date_dim.fulldate BETWEEN Cast('20240101' AS DATE) AND eds_ctl.loans_date
						AND date_dim.Month_End = 'y'
				)
		)          
JOIN eds.loan_fact
	ON loan_fact.as_of_date = fulldate
JOIN eds.lns_acctauthsign aas
	ON aas.acid = loan_fact.gam_acid
	AND aas.bank_id = loan_fact.gam_bank_id
	AND aas.as_of_date = loan_fact.as_of_date
JOIN eds.lns_laacctmast lam
	ON aas.acid = lam.acid
	AND aas.bank_id = lam.bank_id
	AND aas.as_of_date BETWEEN lam.scd_start_date AND lam.scd_end_date
WHERE (
		loan_fact.as_of_date = loans_date
		OR (
				lns_account_status <> 'C'
				AND loan_fact.as_of_date <> loans_date
			)
	)
